about:
Hi! My name is Shanav Bagga and I'm currently a Graduate student at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign pursuing a Master's of Computer Science.



I'm extremely passionate about software engineering and data science, with a particular interest in Generative AI and Systems Programming. I'm a huge fan of football and basketball and can be caught watching every Bears and Bulls game. I've only been to 3 countries at the moment but I hope to visit numerous more in the future, especially many European countries. Outside of my time working and studying, I've recently had a growing interest in graphic design and video editing using Canva and Adobe Creative Cloud. Check out the Design section to see some examples of my works!
